basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 28-year-old high school teacher from Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for languages and am currently learning Japanese in my free time. I enjoy trading Pokémon in my spare time and am an active participant in community discussions about intermittent fasting. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during lunch breaks. I'm single and like exploring new places on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics and have always been fascinated by how languages shape our world. I frequently visit linguistic subreddits to learn and share insights. My interest in health and lifestyle choices like intermittent fasting comes from reading online articles and personal experimentation.
